# Vendored dependencies

Single-file libraries, unmodified, so the project builds with nothing but CMake and a C++17 compiler.

| File | Project | Version | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `json.hpp` | [nlohmann/json](https://github.com/nlohmann/json) | 3.11.3 | MIT (header in the file) |
| `sqlite/sqlite3.c`, `sqlite/sqlite3.h` | [SQLite amalgamation](https://sqlite.org/amalgamation.html) | 3.46.1 | Public domain |
| `doctest.h` (tests only) | [doctest](https://github.com/doctest/doctest) | 2.4.11 | MIT (header in the file) |
